name: Geekbench: Background Blur
description: Separates and blurs the background of 10 frames in a 1080p video, using DeepLabV3+.The score is calibrated against a baseline score of 2,500 (Dell Precision 3460 with a Core i7-12700 processor) as per the Geekbench 6 Benchmark Internals.
note: This benchmark does not scale well on instances with more than 32 vCPUs. Empirical data shows measured scores plateau and may even degrade as vCPU count increases, so it is not recommended for evaluating larger instance sizes.
